comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
A white-name Ganador, he can be challenged when the World Clock is set to the 16th Century's fourth or fifth periods, or if one equips Adept of Ages (16th Century-P.4) / Adept of Ages (16th Century-P.5) titles or Age effect (16th century) EX Effect equipment. It's necessary to defeat him once in order to unlock the more powerful Ganador of the same era, Francis Drake.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?Ganador/List

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Can potentially drop the following when defeated:

Medium Storm Sail
Noble Metal Paneling (removed on Maris)
English Crest
English Admiral Outfit
Breath of Passion
Flag of England (removed on Maris)

Useエフィンガム with Ctrl-F to locate his Ganador map on the following page:

66noa.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-44.html
